correctness.rationale: The four-state backward generator and its mixed incoming absorbing boundary conditions give exact conditional quadratic mean functions and a triangular polynomial system for second moments. All coefficients are recovered by elementary integration, including the stalled-state terms. The exact mean, variance and squared coefficient of variation depend on the split through the nonnegative product parameter only; their three derivatives are uniformly positive on the allowed interval, with a simple inequality proving the relative-risk derivative positive. Uniform finite-time contact probability supplies exponential tails even when one individual never reverses. The standalone verification.py independently checks the generator identities and algebra symbolically and 240,000 seeded event-driven sample paths; finite tests are not substituted for the proof.

originality.rationale: The assessed assertion is the exact full-budget simultaneous global optimization of first-contact mean, absolute variance and squared coefficient of variation for unequal *individual* reversal rates under fixed sum. The closest preexisting claims either assume a shared rate, vary speeds with a shared rate, or optimize a stationary separation exponent under a different confining interaction. The inspected primary ring-jamming paper treats steady-state laws and supplies the model rather than this first-contact three-statistic ordering. Specialized equal-rate formulas and the generator method are acknowledged as prior, not renamed as new. Available targeted literature and indexed comparisons did not reveal a statement implying the quantified allocation theorem. Priority outside the accessible literature remains uncertain.
residual_risks: An inaccessible, unindexed or older two-phase first-passage source could already include the joint unequal-rate budget theorem; no universal novelty certificate is claimed.
Matrix-fluid-queue first-passage techniques may imply parts of the exact rational moment polynomials, although no inspected application states the strict three-risk optimizer.
The equal-rate specialization reproduces known regimes and is not asserted as independently new.

value.rationale: Fixed total individual tumbling frequency is a motivated allocation constraint for two equal-speed active searchers on a ring, and the first-contact mean, absolute variance and coefficient of variation describe distinct operational objectives. Their exact simultaneous strict ordering is not a parameter renaming, a trivial consequence of a previously known formula, or an arbitrary small-number computation: it provides a natural complete allocation classification for every positive budget, including singular boundary controls. The result shows concentrating reversals in only one particle improves all three objectives despite balanced control usually being a natural default, giving a reproducible sharp baseline for design of paired search and encounter processes. It does not rely on asserted downstream general theorems.
